project.name: OpenID4VCI Test Fixtures
project.description: Test-scope-only fixtures. The OID4VCI spec repository doesn't ship a bulk examples/ directory the way OpenID4VP's does, so most fixtures here are hand-transcribed from the spec's own published JSON examples (src/main/resources-spec-transcribed) rather than copied wholesale from a vendored docs/ directory -- each transcribed file's header comment cites the spec section it came from, so drift is still checkable by inspection.
